## What changes

## Checklist

- [ ] There is an issue where this change was agreed (or it is a small bug fix)
- [ ] One change only, no unrelated refactors or formatting
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `composer test` passes
- [ ] `composer analyse` passes without new baseline entries or ignores
- [ ] `composer format` was run
- [ ] README updated if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No new dependencies, or they were agreed in the issue
- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit message (`fix: …`, `feat: …`)
